'''Darth Silthar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We came to Tatooine to solve a mystery&mdash;one of dead men and desert secrets. Not for conquest, but for power.|Darth Silthar|<ref name="TOR" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Silthar served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the first quarter of the Inter-Sith Wars period. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he had proven to be one of the strongest [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] and ascended to the title of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]].<ref name="TOR" /> He had also successfully trained his apprentice [[Hargrev]] and brought him to [[Lord/Legends|lordship]].<ref name="Revealed" />

Silthar often worked with the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Barden Golah]]. During their time together, he found a lost temple on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] and the crystal caves of [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]]. Around [[3643 BBY]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he led the [[Reclamation Service Tatooine expedition|investigation]] into the secrets of the long abandoned [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] base. At some point, he was captured by the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] after he slaughtered a number during his search for the secrets he sought. He was found injured inside of one of the caves by an Imperial individual, where he [[Death/Legends|died]] soon afterwards.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Silthar first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. Silthar's means of death is dependent on the player's choice. Sparing Silthar before destroying the Sand People mural (thus leaving him to succumb to his injuries) is the light side option; the player may also choose the dark side option and kill Silthar themselves, then destroy the mural.<ref name="TOR" />
